EV Charge Points in Norwich and Norfolk

We install home EV charge points across Norwich and Norfolk. Most installs take around half a day, survey dependent, and start at £900 plus VAT.

Call 07576 485671 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

We specify only known and proven brands such as Pod Point and Ohme. Each installation is planned thoroughly and carried out to current regulations.

What the Price Covers

The installation of the EV charging unit, the consumer unit work that goes with it, and the inspection, testing and certification. We are an OZEV approved installer and an Ohme Approved installer.

Servicing a Charge Point You Already Have

We also maintain and service EV charging points, from £100 plus VAT.

Photos From Our EV Charge Points Jobs

A New Charger for a New Car

A customer needed a charge point for a new car. We ran new meter tails into an EV consumer unit, then cabled from there around the property to where the charger was going. Six hours in total, including all the testing and certification.
